main_text.p: fundamento, five primordio: non quidem actu & physice, sed moraliter, quod ad valorem, acceptationem, & certitudinem mactationis suo tempore actu futurae. Quae, uti in contractibus bonae fidei, quando sponsor habetur sufficiens & probus, quamvis solutio nondum revera praestita, propter bonam tamen certamque fidem, habetur rata, valuit etiam tempore omni, a primo promissi Christi exordio. Atque hoc nisi potuisset Christus, id est unica oblatione sanctificare omnes, quandocunque vixerint, oportuisset eum pluries pati σταυρουος ...
Note: the Greek phrase here is printed as "πολλάκις κατά κόσμο&#x C5;" — see notes.

page.notes: The scan is small and the Greek and Hebrew passages are only partly legible; the transcription above is incomplete and must not be relied on. The Greek after "pluries pati" (Hebr. 9:26 context: "ἀπὸ καταβολῆς κόσμου") and the Hebrew/Greek of the citations could not be read reliably and are marked as uncertain. The following remainder of the page was not transcribed in full in this attempt: the paragraph beginning "Excipiunt ad locum Hebr. xiii. 8.", the paragraph "Quin potius per voces Heri & hodie", the remaining running text to the bottom of the page, and the citations (Iobi 8, Exod. 4, 1 Cor. xv. 22). This transcription is therefore incomplete and needs to be redone for the full page.
